name: dots
title: Dots
description: Tiny Tailwind circles for color, status, selection, and presence signals.
useWhen: A compact visual signal is more useful than a full badge or text label.
avoidWhen: The state requires an explanation that cannot be conveyed by a label nearby.
responsiveBehavior: Dots retain a fixed visual size across viewports.
accessibility: ColorDot is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
StatusDot includes a readable status label alongside its color.

variants.title: Color dot
variants.description: A decorative colored circle for palettes, selection cues, and compact visual accents.
accessibility: Hide decorative dots from assistive technology.

variants.title: Status dot
variants.description: A colored status signal that pairs the visual dot with a readable text label.
accessibility: Never use color as the only status signal.
